name: Erbil

queries.query: أربيل دائرة التسجيل العقاري خارطة عقار خريطة كاداستر GIS قطع أراضي
queries.result: KRG official services list Erbil property registration directorates and a property-boundary/map service. It requires an owner/attorney, latest registration copy and ID documents, with fees and in-office survey. KRSO GIS describes administrative boundaries/topography, not cadastre. No anonymous parcel viewer/API found.
queries.method: Arabic/English search and first-party KRG service page/catalog review.
